image_title: Department of Defense Rate Reduction and Improvement Metrics
summary: This table presents the rate reduction and percent improvement metrics for various branches of the Department of Defense (DOD) from Fiscal Year 2002 (FY 02) to Fiscal Year 2009 (FY 09). It includes data for All DOD, Army, Navy, Marines, Air Force, and Defense Logistics, highlighting the rate reductions achieved and the corresponding percentage improvements. The Marines show the highest percent improvement at 50%, while the Air Force has the lowest at 36%. Overall, the data indicates significant reductions across all branches, with the Navy achieving a 46% improvement.
table_rows: All DOD: FY 02 = 31.5, FY 09 = 18.7, Rate Reduction = 12.8, Percent Improvement = 41%

Navy: FY 02 = 39.8, FY 09 = 21.2, Rate Reduction = 18.6, Percent Improvement = 46%
Marines: FY 02 = 73.8, FY 09 = 36.7, Rate Reduction = 37.1, Percent Improvement = 50%
Air Force: FY 02 = 25.6, FY 09 = 16.5, Rate Reduction = 9.1, Percent Improvement = 36%
Defense Logistics: FY 02 = 25.6, FY 09 = 16.9, Rate Reduction = 8.7, Percent Improvement = 34%
